scope: Exact source-62 CPU-profile contract plus two selected-kernel baseline-JIT userspace probes. Both pinned diagnostic archives return seven matching UUID-bound workloads and host-observed ACPI S5. This closes the conservative versioned profile audit in P02-09, not the Linux CPU baseline in P02-10.
limitations: The two profiles remain conservative versioned Dory engineering identities; neither represents a physical Intel SKU nor a qualified x86-64-v2/v3 baseline.
PAT, XSAVE, OSXSAVE, AVX, AVX2, RDTSCP and invariant TSC remain absent from the selected profiles.

The probes cover two selected Alpine kernel builds, two pinned diagnostic archives, baseline JIT with interpreter fallback and one vCPU. They do not qualify all distributions, optimizing JIT, multi-vCPU, physical reference, hosted CI or performance.
The two kernel images have different internal layouts but their retained ELF PT_LOAD envelopes are identical.

Raw producer metadata uses the erroneous non-resolving abbreviation b930793f5a. Exact source-manifest, runner, build-log and repository bindings establish the actual implementation commit without rewriting the raw records.
P02-10 and broad CPU/ISA/floating-point/paging qualification remain open.
